info.title: Products API
info.description:
RESTful API to manage products and their prices in multiple currencies.

**Authentication:** call `POST /auth/login` to obtain a Bearer token (valid for 60 minutes),
then send it in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. `POST /auth/logout` revokes it.

**Authorization:** every endpoint requires a permission. The `admin` role has all of them;
the `seller` role can view, create and update products, view and register prices, and view currencies.

**Money:** amounts are returned as strings with fixed decimals (e.g. `"19.90"`) to avoid floating-point errors.

**Errors:** every error body has a `message`; validation errors (422) also include `errors` per field.

post.description: Public endpoint. Returns a Bearer token valid for 60 minutes. Unknown email and wrong password get the same 422 error on `email` ("These credentials do not match our records."), so existing accounts are never revealed. Limited to 5 attempts per minute for each email + IP pair.
Revokes only the token used for this request; other sessions of the user stay active. No permission required.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user with roles and effective permissions. No permission required.
Requires `currencies.view`. Paginated list ordered by code.

post.description: Requires `currencies.create`. `exchange_rate` is the number of units of the new currency per 1 USD. Name and code must be unique.

put.description: Requires `currencies.update`. Partial update: only the fields sent are validated and changed (PATCH is also accepted). For the base currency (USD) the code cannot be changed and the exchange rate must stay 1 (422).

delete.description: Requires `currencies.delete`. Returns 409 "The base currency cannot be deleted." for USD, and 409 "The currency is in use and cannot be deleted." when a product uses it as base currency or has a price in it.

get.description: Requires `roles.view`. Fixed catalog of permissions (seeded, never created through the API), sorted by name and not paginated.
Requires `products.view`. Paginated list ordered by id; each product includes its base currency (not the prices in other currencies).

post.description: Requires `products.create`. The name accepts letters, spaces and hyphens only (digits are rejected). When `currency_id` is omitted the base currency (USD) is used.

get.description: Requires `products.view`. Includes the base currency and the prices registered in other currencies.

put.description: Requires `products.update`. Partial update: only the fields sent are validated and changed (PATCH is also accepted). `currency_id` cannot be a currency in which the product already has a price (422: "The product already has a price in this currency.").

delete.description: Requires `products.delete`. The prices of the product in other currencies are deleted with it.

get.summary: List the prices of a product
get.description: Requires `prices.view`. Paginated list, ordered by id, of the prices of the product in currencies other than its base currency.

post.summary: Register a price of a product
post.description: Requires `prices.create`. Registers the price of the product in another currency: the currency must differ from the product base currency (422) and the product can have only one price per currency (422: "The product already has a price in this currency."). Returns 409 with that same message when a concurrent request registered the same currency first.

get.description: Requires `roles.view`. Paginated list ordered by id; each role includes its permissions and the number of users holding it.

post.description: Requires `roles.create`. Delegation rule: you can only grant permissions you hold (403 "You cannot grant permissions you do not hold.").

200.description: The role with its permissions and users count.

put.description:
Requires `roles.update`. Partial update: only the fields sent are validated and changed (PATCH is also accepted); `permissions` replaces all the permissions of the role.

Delegation rule (403): "You cannot grant permissions you do not hold."

Conflict (409): "The admin role cannot be modified or deleted."

delete.description: Requires `roles.delete`. Conflicts (409): "The admin role cannot be modified or deleted." and "The role is assigned to users and cannot be deleted."

get.description: Requires `users.view`. Paginated list ordered by id; each user includes roles and effective permissions.

post.description: Requires `users.create`. Delegation rule: you can only assign a role whose permissions you all hold (403 "You cannot assign a role with permissions you do not hold.").

200.description: The user with roles and effective permissions.

put.description:
Requires `users.update`. Partial update: only the fields sent are validated and changed (PATCH is also accepted).

Delegation rules (403): "You cannot manage a user with permissions you do not hold." and "You cannot assign a role with permissions you do not hold."

Conflicts (409): "You cannot change your own role." and "The last administrator cannot be removed or demoted."

Changing the password revokes every session of the user, except the current one when you change your own password.

delete.description:
Requires `users.delete`. Every session of the deleted user is revoked.

Delegation rule (403): "You cannot manage a user with permissions you do not hold."

Conflicts (409): "You cannot delete your own account." and "The last administrator cannot be removed or demoted."

expires_at.description: Moment the token stops being valid (60 minutes after login).

id.description: A currency and its exchange rate against the base currency (USD).

exchange_rate.description: Units of this currency per 1 USD (USD is the base currency, rate 1). Example: EUR 0.89 means 1 USD = 0.89 EUR. Returned as a string with 6 decimals.

first.description: Navigation links of a paginated list.

current_page.description: Page information of a paginated list.

id.description: A permission from the fixed, seeded catalog.
A product with its base price, costs and currency.

description.example: Ergonomic wireless mouse with USB receiver.

price.description: Base price in the product currency, 2 decimals.

tax_cost.description: Tax cost in the product currency, 2 decimals.

manufacturing_cost.description: Manufacturing cost in the product currency, 2 decimals.

prices.description: Prices in other currencies. Present only in the show and update responses.

id.description: Price of a product in a currency other than its base currency.
A role with its permissions and the number of users holding it.

permissions.description: Names of the permissions granted by the role, sorted by name.

users_count.description: Number of users holding the role.

code.description: 3-letter uppercase ISO 4217 code. Must be unique.

exchange_rate.description: Units of this currency per 1 USD. Must be greater than 0, max 999999.999999, up to 6 decimals.

currency_id.description: ID of an existing currency. Must differ from the product base currency, and the product must not have a price in it yet.

price.description: Price in that currency. Must be greater than 0, max 9999999999.99, up to 2 decimals.

name.description: Letters (any language, accents included), spaces and hyphens only, with at least one letter; digits, symbols, tabs and line breaks are rejected.

description.example: Ergonomic wireless mouse with USB receiver.

price.description: Base price in the product currency. Must be greater than 0, max 9999999999.99, up to 2 decimals.

currency_id.description: ID of an existing currency. Optional: defaults to the base currency (USD).

tax_cost.description: Tax cost in the product currency. 0 or greater, max 9999999999.99, up to 2 decimals.

manufacturing_cost.description: Manufacturing cost in the product currency. 0 or greater, max 9999999999.99, up to 2 decimals.

name.description: Lowercase; starts with a letter and may contain letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Must be unique.

permissions.description: At least one distinct, existing permission name. You can only grant permissions you hold.

name.description: Data to create a user with a role.

role.description: Name of an existing role. You can only assign a role whose permissions you all hold.

code.description: 3-letter uppercase ISO 4217 code. Must be unique. The base currency (USD) code cannot be changed.

exchange_rate.description: Units of this currency per 1 USD. Must be greater than 0, max 999999.999999, up to 6 decimals. The base currency (USD) rate must stay 1.

name.description: Letters (any language, accents included), spaces and hyphens only, with at least one letter; digits, symbols, tabs and line breaks are rejected.

description.example: Ergonomic wireless mouse with USB-C receiver.

price.description: Base price in the product currency. Must be greater than 0, max 9999999999.99, up to 2 decimals.

currency_id.description: ID of an existing currency. Must not be a currency in which the product already has a price.

tax_cost.description: Tax cost in the product currency. 0 or greater, max 9999999999.99, up to 2 decimals.

manufacturing_cost.description: Manufacturing cost in the product currency. 0 or greater, max 9999999999.99, up to 2 decimals.

name.description: Lowercase; starts with a letter and may contain letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Must be unique.

permissions.description: Replaces all the permissions of the role. At least one distinct, existing permission name; you can only grant permissions you hold.

name.description: Partial update of a user: only the fields sent are validated and changed.

password.description: At least 8 characters; requires `password_confirmation`. Changing it revokes the user's other sessions.

role.description: Name of an existing role; replaces the current role. You can only assign a role whose permissions you all hold.

id.description: A user with its roles and effective permissions.

roles.description: Names of the roles assigned to the user.

permissions.description: Effective permissions granted through the roles, sorted by name.

message.description: Body of a 422 response: a summary message plus the errors of each field.

Forbidden.description: The user lacks the required permission.

Conflict.description: The action conflicts with the current state of the resource.

ServerError.description: Unexpected error; details are logged, never returned.

sanctum.description: Sanctum token obtained from POST /auth/login. Expires after 60 minutes.
